description: Show who you are operating as: the authenticated AgentCard account's email, user id, name, plan, KYC + account status, member-since date, and how this session is connected (personal login vs a third-party OAuth app connection, with the app name). Call this when the user asks "who am I" / "which account is this", or before money-moving actions when you need to confirm the account. Read-only. KYC shown here is the stored snapshot — use get_kyc_status when you need the live, provider-checked state.
name: whoami

connectionClientId.description: OAuth client id of the connected app, when connectionType is oauth, or organization through a company's app.

connectionClientName.description: Display name of the connected OAuth app (e.g. "Claude"), when known, for an oauth or organization connection.

connectionOrganizationId.description: Organization id, when connectionType is organization.

connectionType.description: How this session authenticates: 'oauth' (third-party app connection), 'personal' (CLI/dashboard login), or 'organization' (a company's Agentcard integration acting for its end user).

email.description: Email of the authenticated account, or null for a phone-first account (e.g. signed up by text message).

kycStatus.description: Raw stored KYC state (e.g. approved, pending, requires_input), or null if never started.

kycVerified.description: Whether identity verification (KYC) has passed (stored snapshot).

memberSince.description: ISO timestamp the account was created.

name.description: Cardholder name ("First Last"), or null before KYC info is submitted.

subscriptionStatus.description: Stripe subscription status (e.g. 'active', 'past_due'), or null on the free plan.

userId.description: AgentCard user id of the authenticated account.
